title: Settings
youIntro: Only you see these. Your theme and language follow you. Match system is set per phone.
familyIntro: Everyone in the family shares these. Any member can change them.

credits.title: Credits
credits.hint: Shared by everyone in your family. A read of a photo, a Voice Note, a recipe from a link or a Suggest Guidance uses Credits.
credits.low: Your family is running low on Credits.

expiringSoon.title: Expiring soon
expiringSoon.hint: Batches turn amber this many days before they expire

allergies.title: Allergies
allergies.hint: Pick what you must avoid, intolerances included. Recipes that contain it get a warning.
allergies.familyCanSee: Everyone in your family can see your Allergies.
allergies.loadFailed: Could not load the Allergen list.
allergies.saveFailed: Could not save your Allergies. Try again.
allergies.noAccount: Someone without an account? Add a Family Allergy in the Family tab.
allergies.hideRecipesHint: Leaves out Recipes with your Allergies, or your Family Allergies, from the Recipes list, Can Make, Cook tonight and Plate Scan matches. Other members' Allergies never hide a Recipe. You can still open any Recipe, and the Meal Plan shows everything.
allergies.hideSaveFailed: Could not save this setting. Try again.

catalogLanguage.label: Catalog Language
catalogLanguage.hint: Names of Ingredients, Categories and Aisles. Shown in {{language}}.
catalogLanguage.saveFailed: Could not save your Catalog Language. Try again.

scanLanguage.label: Scan Language
scanLanguage.hint: What photos are read as. Reading in {{language}}.
scanLanguage.saveFailed: Could not save your Scan Language. Try again.

spokenLanguage.label: Spoken Language
spokenLanguage.hint: What Voice Notes are spoken in. Listening in {{language}}.
spokenLanguage.saveFailed: Could not save your Spoken Language. Try again.

localeSaveFailed: Could not save your language. Try again.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.matchSystemHint: Dark-first when the phone is in dark mode, your light theme otherwise
appearance.syncedOnDevice: Theme saved on this phone. We'll sync it when you're online.
appearance.lightOnlyToast: {{name}} shows when the phone is in light mode.
appearance.darkEverywhereToast: Dark-first everywhere. Match system is off.

defaultExpiry.title: Default expiry
defaultExpiry.hint: Pre-fills the date when anyone in the family adds a batch. Categories you leave out use the Catalog default.
defaultExpiry.empty: Catalog defaults are used for every category. Add one to set your own.

familyCatalog.title: Family catalog
familyCatalog.help: What your family added to the catalog. Anyone in the family can fix it.
familyCatalog.name: Name
familyCatalog.hint: Swipe left to delete · tap to edit
familyCatalog.checkLine_one: {{count}} ingredient is not checked for allergens. Tap one to tag it.
familyCatalog.checkLine_other: {{count}} ingredients are not checked for allergens. Tap one to tag it.
familyCatalog.pickHint: For {{name}}. It sets the Aisle and where its batches go.
familyCatalog.allergensHintUnchecked: Not checked yet. Pick what it contains, or None.
familyCatalog.otherNamesHint: Your family can also find it as these.
familyCatalog.usageNoteDelete: Deleting keeps them as unmatched items under this name.
familyCatalog.nameTaken: “{{name}}” is already in the catalog. Pick another name.
familyCatalog.empty: When a search finds nothing, “Add to your catalog” puts the name here for the whole family.
familyCatalog.synonymsHint: Names your family uses for an ingredient, in search, scans and receipts.
familyCatalog.synonymInfo: Your family sees {{name}} in search, scans and receipts, and it means {{ingredient}}. To make it mean something else, remove it and add it again from search.

familyAllergies.title: Family Allergies
familyAllergies.hint: For people in your family without an account, like a child. Any member can add or remove them, and they count as everyone's Allergies.
familyAllergies.label: Label (optional)
familyAllergies.labelHint: Who it is for, like Mia
familyAllergies.loadFailed: Could not load the Family's Allergies.

memberAllergies.title: Members' Allergies
memberAllergies.hint: Each member sets their own Allergies. You can see them here but not change them.
memberAllergies.loadFailed: Could not load the members' Allergies.

manageTags.title: Manage Tags
manageTags.hint: Your family's own Tags. Rename one to tidy it up, or delete one to remove it from every Recipe.
manageTags.empty: Your family has no Tags of its own yet. Create one from a Recipe's Tags field.

merge.title: Merge into ‘{{name}}’?
merge.body: A Tag named ‘{{name}}’ already exists. Merging puts it on every Recipe that has ‘{{from}}’ and removes ‘{{from}}’. A Recipe that has both keeps it once.
